description: Fetch one CRM customer summary in the selected workspace by company id: a company that bought (a purchase order — processing, shipped, delivered or refunded, or with a settled payment — or a won deal that never became an order). Returns health, lifetimeValue (completed-order revenue plus won deals without an order), purchases (purchase orders plus won deals without an order), repeat (two or more purchases), lastPurchaseAt and wonDealsCount (every won deal). Read-only; a company with no purchase is not found. Use list_customers first when you only know the company name.

companyId.description: The company/customer id returned by list_customers.
